steps.content: You slip out the door and make your way to Marlo's room.
Like Hilda's, it's a spacious master bedroom.
You begin your search, moving with deliberate caution.
You feel a cold blade pressed against your back.

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: I just went to your room. Didn't expect to find you here.

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: I know I'm not the mole, so it has to be one of the other three. So why bother figuring out which one when I can just kill you all?

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: So I took care of Manphist first. Then I went for Helene.

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: When I killed Helene, I found this.
A hand reaches over your shoulder, a blood-stained letter pinched between her fingers.

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: She kept this on her as a lucky charm. Pathetic, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: So it was you. You're the mole who infiltrated us!

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: Once you're gone, this is over. Hilda and I can finally get out of here alive!
